facts.related_party_note: The Company has transactions with related parties including borrowings from GHIAL (subsidiary) of Rs 141.20 Crore at 11% per annum, and certain shares pledged by promoters as security towards borrowings of the Company and related parties. Remuneration to KMP includes amounts paid by erstwhile GAL. Transactions are stated to be on arms' length basis. Outstanding balances are unsecured and will be settled in due course. Amounts below Rs 50,000 not reported due to rounding.
